
```{r}
#| label: validate_inputs
#| include: false

# Fail early with a clear message when the report inputs are missing, before
# any data is loaded
if (!is.character(params$sample_sheet) || !file.exists(params$sample_sheet)) {
  stop(
    "`sample_sheet` does not point to an existing file: ",
    paste(params$sample_sheet, collapse = ", "),
    call. = FALSE
  )
}
if (!is.null(params$data_folder) && !dir.exists(params$data_folder)) {
  stop(
    "`data_folder` does not point to an existing directory: ",
    paste(params$data_folder, collapse = ", "),
    call. = FALSE
  )
}

validate_es_technology(params$technology)
```
